then.text: Enjoy the pill tin. It's empty. Please don't fill it with anything from the Victorian street gallery.

else.text: This was a workhouse. Then a hospital. Now a museum of how we stopped dying of everything. Progress!
For the market? Have an old pill tin. Leeds was famous for surgical instruments, you know. Very sharp people.
{greeting} Before sewers, cholera swept through Leeds in 1832 and again later. Doctors worked out it was the water, not bad smells, and the city built proper drains.
Try the gallery where you're the patient. Nobody comes out without wincing.
